lime-sprout.$description: Lime Sprout — Primary action button, icon highlights, accent tags — the singular chromatic punctuation that makes actions feel switched on against the cream canvas

paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Page canvas, hero background, section backgrounds — warm off-white that replaces standard white with a paper-like quality

ivory-card.$description: Ivory Card — Alternate card surface, warm-toned elevated panels that sit one step deeper than the cream canvas

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Elevated card surfaces, product screenshot containers, button text on dark fills

slate-border.$description: Slate Border — Card borders, hairline dividers between content sections and list items

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted link borders, nav underlines, subtle structural dividers

stone.$description: Stone — Helper text, tertiary body content, subdued annotations

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, icon strokes, subdued UI labels

iron.$description: Iron — Dark surface elements, body borders on inverted sections

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary text, dark filled buttons, heading color — the near-black that carries all weight in the type system

onyx.$description: Onyx — Maximum-contrast borders, footer rules, SVG fills where absolute black is needed

figtree.$description: Primary typeface across all UI — display, headings, body, nav, buttons. Weight 300 at 72px hero is a signature choice: whisper-light headlines that feel editorial and confident rather than bold-and-shouting. The geometric humanist forms of Figtree at 300 weight give the warm cream canvas a modern editorial feel.

inter.$description: Secondary body text at 16–20px, likely fallback or supplementary paragraph copy. Used sparingly alongside Figtree for longer-form descriptive text.
